profile.headline: Software Engineer at Giant Eagle, Inc.
profile.summary: Detail-oriented, organized and meticulous employee. Works at fast pace to meet tight deadlines. Enthusiastic team player ready to contribute to company success.

positions.title: IT Project Manager
positions.description:
-Develop scope and high level requirements for projects.
-Develop, publish and monitor the project schedule.
-Manage project risks to ensure they are quickly identified, communicated, and mitigated.
-Provide accurate and up to date project status reports.
-Manage the implementation of new technology (hardware and software) throughout over 500 retail locations.
-Provide assistance to project team members in the execution of assigned tasks.
-Ensure that all deliverables and documentation is created, meets standards, and is properly maintained according to established processes.
-Ensure that operations support plans are in place and established prior to project closure.

positions.title: Programmer analyst / Point of Sale
positions.description:
- Responsible for maintaining the solution and system requirements of application development projects.  
- Execute systems and integration testing.  
- Ensure appropriate documentation concerning project deliverables and system support processes, distribute them to affected parties and maintain them as necessary.
 - Work with vendor software providers to ensure the design and system changes are supported by the vendor. 
 - Assist in moving projects and tasks through the change management process.
 - Planning and execution for Systems training and support.
 - Elaborate system manuals for hand off to operation teams prior to production release or implementation. 
- Primary contact for production issues escalation (business and off hours). 
- Work with end users in order to gather important data necessary for troubleshooting.
 - Work with IT and Business team members to resolve production issues.  
- Support the deployment and launch of projects and releases.

positions.title: Helpdesk Associate
positions.description:
-Project Account: Giant Eagle 
-Provided technical support to retail and corporate end-users.
 -Responsible for dispatching field technicians to retail sites.
 -Generated operational troubleshooting documentation for client's knowledge base. 
-Recognized for providing personal yet efficient customer service.

positions.title: International Cultural Representative
positions.description:
Participated in a program that recruits outgoing and hospitality oriented people throughout the world to represent their culture, traditions and history of their countries to the guests visiting the resort.   

Responsibilities:  
-Greeting and interacting with Guests of all ages.
 -Monitoring guest safety and flow. 
-Engaging in cultural activities.
